core: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation and signaling
qualifier: spanning NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptors
name: NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation and signaling
rationale: All members concern activation, trafficking or downstream effects of ionotropic glutamate receptors at excitatory synapses; unlike the CREB/CaMK-downstream and AMPA-clustering neighbours, the theme covers receptor activation itself including kainate receptors.

qualifier: Notch/TSR O-fucose/O-glucose and heparan sulfate
name: Notch O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members are O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins plus EXT1/EXT2 heparan sulfate synthesis; the Notch arm separates it from chondroitin/dermatan GAG neighbours and the heparan sulfate arm from the somitogenesis and N-glycan neighbours.

qualifier: antigen processing and PD-L1 turnover
name: Proteasome assembly, antigen processing and PD-L1 degradation
rationale: Members centre on the proteasome and its assembly, proteasomal antigen processing for CD8 T cells and PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation; PD-L1 turnover distinguishes it from the Nef/Vpu and MHC class I loading neighbours.

qualifier: RET/GDNF and endothelin enteric nervous system development
name: Enteric nervous system development and visceral smooth muscle motility
rationale: Members combine RET/GDNF and endothelin-driven enteric neural crest development with gut and urinary smooth muscle motility; the enteric neural arm separates it from reproductive and generic smooth muscle neighbours, and the GI motility arm from vascular endothelin neighbours.

qualifier: with telomere maintenance and repair-coupled replication
name: DNA repair, damage response and telomere maintenance
rationale: Members cover every major DNA repair route (BER, NER, MMR, HR, NHEJ, TLS, ICL repair), damage checkpoints and telomere maintenance; this breadth distinguishes it from the chromatin-assembly, Cajal-body, cisplatin-response and replication-initiation neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation via VEGF and growth factor production
name: Positive regulation of VEGF production and sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members promote VEGF production/signalling, TGF-beta2 production and endothelial migration and proliferation in sprouting angiogenesis; the growth factor production arm and positive direction separate it from the negative-regulation and generic angiogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: laminin, anchoring fibril and collagen trimerization
name: Basement membrane laminin and anchoring fibril assembly
rationale: Members are laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerization, anchoring fibril formation and basement membrane regulation; the laminin/anchoring fibril focus distinguishes it from the fibronectin, elastic fibre and collagen crosslinking neighbours.

qualifier: aggresome formation and selective autophagy
name: Aggresome formation and autophagic clearance of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern responses to misfolded proteins via aggresome assembly, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy and complex stability; the aggregate/autophagy route distinguishes it from folding-chaperone, ERAD/ubiquitin and stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: of B cell receptor, interleukin and myeloid genes
name: RUNX-family transcriptional control of immune and myeloid genes
rationale: All members are RUNX1/2/3-mediated transcription of BCR, interleukin and myeloid differentiation genes; the RUNX-driven target-gene framing distinguishes it from the granulopoiesis and monocyte differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: via ERAD, reticulophagy and aggrephagy
name: Misfolded protein clearance via ERAD, reticulophagy and aggrephagy
rationale: Members cover protein quality control by ERAD regulation, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and unfolding; the ERAD/reticulophagy and inclusion-body arms distinguish it from aggresome-only, ribosome QC and stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: by oncogenic RAF/RAS mutants and integrin coupling
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF mutants and integrins
rationale: Members are RAF-to-MAPK activation by BRAF/RAF1 mutants, fusions and RAS mutants plus GRB2:SOS and p130Cas integrin linkage; integrin coupling and RAF mutants separate it from MRAS/SHOC2, Rap1 and negative-feedback neighbours.

qualifier: hemidesmosome assembly via integrins and laminins
name: Hemidesmosome and basement membrane adhesion via integrins and laminins
rationale: Members are integrin and laminin interactions, collagen trimerization, anchoring fibrils and hemidesmosome assembly; hemidesmosomes distinguish it from DGC, collagen crosslinking and desmosome/cell-cell adhesion neighbours.

qualifier: proteasome-dependent peptide generation and loading
name: Proteasome-dependent MHC class I antigen processing and loading
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly and function together with endogenous and cross-presented peptide loading onto MHC class I; the class I loading arm separates it from the Nef/Vpu and PD-L1 neighbours and the proteasome arm from broader MHC class II neighbours.

qualifier: nephric duct and nephron tubule segment differentiation
name: Nephric duct and nephron tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, pronephros and metanephric nephron tubule segment (distal tubule, loop of Henle, collecting duct) morphogenesis; segment differentiation distinguishes it from ureteric bud branching and kidney growth-control neighbours.

qualifier: bone and dentin mineralization
name: Regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members concern regulation of bone mineralization, dentinogenesis, secretory protein phosphorylation and chondrocyte development; the dentin/bone matrix mineralization focus separates it from FGF23-phosphate, enamel and osteoclast neighbours.

qualifier: TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and regulation
name: Endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signaling regulation
rationale: All members involve nucleic-acid-sensing endosomal TLRs, their UNC93B1/SLC15A4-dependent trafficking and regulation; this receptor-level focus distinguishes it from the downstream IRF/interferon and cytosolic sensing neighbours.

qualifier: with Rab geranylgeranylation and activation
name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members combine non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, PI and PC between membranes with Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF activation; the Rab prenylation arm distinguishes it from flippase, phospholipid catabolism and Golgi traffic neighbours, and glycolipid transport from the Wnt secretion neighbour.

qualifier: outer segment morphogenesis and maintenance
name: Photoreceptor outer segment morphogenesis and maintenance
rationale: Members concern photoreceptor and cone morphogenesis, outer segment organization, protein targeting and maintenance; this distinguishes it from retinal neuron differentiation and generic ciliary transport neighbours.

qualifier: optic cup, retina, iris and pigmentation
name: Embryonic optic cup morphogenesis and eye pigmentation
rationale: Members are optic cup, embryonic retina and iris morphogenesis plus eye pigmentation; the optic-cup derivatives distinguish it from craniofacial/inner ear and lens/cornea neighbours.

core: mRNA poly(A) tail dynamics and decay
qualifier: polyadenylation plus deadenylation and decapping
name: mRNA polyadenylation, deadenylation and decapping-mediated decay
rationale: Members cover mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation, poly(A) shortening, decapping and 5'-3' decay; polyadenylation separates it from ARE-binding and miRNA neighbours and deadenylation from histone mRNA processing neighbours.

qualifier: with mesenchymal stem cell expansion and Wnt
name: Mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation plus Wnt signalling; the progenitor/Wnt arm distinguishes it from ossification, tendon and mineralization neighbours.

qualifier: with lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors and BCAA catabolism
name: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, cofactors and branched-chain amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are PDH, OGDH, BCKDH and OADH reactions, their lipoate/biotin/CoA cofactors and branched-chain and lysine catabolism with their disorders; this distinguishes it from fatty acid oxidation, vitamin B6 and TCA-enzyme/Fe-S neighbours.

qualifier: from mevalonate isoprenoids through sterol branches
name: Mevalonate-isoprenoid and sterol branches of cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members span isoprenoid (IPP, FPP, GGPP) synthesis, lanosterol and the Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes to cholesterol; this sterol synthesis focus distinguishes it from fatty acid and cytochrome P450 disorder neighbours.

qualifier: MYC-driven Pol I and Pol III transcription
name: MYC-driven Pol I/III transcription and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I and III transcription, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly and MYC/G0-G1 growth control; the transcriptional and MYC arm distinguishes it from translation initiation, RNA modification/decay and splicing neighbours.

core: Kinase control of hepatic metabolic transcription
qualifier: glucagon-PKA and AMPK inhibition of ChREBP
name: Glucagon-PKA and AMPK inhibitory phosphorylation of ChREBP
rationale: All three members are fasting-signal kinase (PKA, AMPK) phosphorylation of metabolic factors centred on ChREBP; the inhibitory kinase arm distinguishes it from ChREBP activation/PP2A and insulin-secretion neighbours.
